purpose: Causally test whether input level changes the retained 0.6-second empty natural-ASR result; this is a diagnostic, not an automatic gain policy
hypothesis: Increasing the exact integer PCM amplitude by 4, without clipping or changing duration/prompt/language, may change the shared native/reference empty result. Six metadata-selected quiet controls distinguish this from a general quality improvement.

control_selection.selection: first original metadata row within language with RMS <= -30 dBFS and gain4 fitting int16
last original metadata row within language with RMS <= -30 dBFS and gain4 fitting int16
first original metadata row within language with RMS <= -30 dBFS and gain4 fitting int16
last original metadata row within language with RMS <= -30 dBFS and gain4 fitting int16
first original metadata row within language with RMS <= -30 dBFS and gain4 fitting int16
last original metadata row within language with RMS <= -30 dBFS and gain4 fitting int16

baseline.required: Original PCM values exactly; all seven native text/language/model-identity fields must equal frozen full baseline before interpreting gain results

single_variable.operation: Every signed int16 sample multiplied by 4; assert all fit [-32768,32767]. No clipping, normalization, filtering, dithering, padding, duration or reference alteration.

execution.order: Source metadata order, gain1 then gain4 for each source

metrics: Frozen author mixed-token distance, raw text/language, baseline parity and per-source effects; no output-dependent expansion or further gain search in this pilot
limits: Output changes demonstrate input-level sensitivity for selected recordings only; seven selected recordings are not a general gain acceptance cohort
Correct reference text is not physical listening or intelligibility acceptance
All original corpus/quality/M4 strict/physical/download/distribution gates preserved; no candidate/default promotion
data_attribution: ASCEND, Lovenia et al., LREC 2022, HKUST CAiRE
input_artifacts: Fourteen private WAV files; full case manifest and references retained privately. Existing baseline and generated payload hashes verified by the private analyzer.
